rete.definition: n a network of intersecting blood vessels or intersecting nerves or intersecting lymph vessels

rete mirabile simplex.translation: [医] 单纯异网(单种血管网)

retem.definition: n desert shrub of Syria and Arabia having small white flowers; constitutes the juniper of the Old Testament; sometimes placed in genus Genista

retene.definition:
n. A white crystalline hydrocarbon, polymeric with benzene. It
   is extracted from pine tar, and is also found in certain fossil resins.

retentate.translation: n. ( 在渗析过程中未能通过半透膜而被保留下的) 保留物,滞留物

retention.definition: n. the act of retaining something
retention.translation:
n. 保持, 留置, 保留, 保持力, 保留物, 记忆, 停滞, 固位
[计] 保贸, 保持

retention analysis.translation: [化] 残留分析; 保留分析; 保留分析法

retention discipline.translation: [计] 保存规同, 保留规则

retention of color.translation: [化] 保色性; 着色稳定性

retention of food.translation: [医] 食物停滞(指在机体内)

retention of records.translation: [化] 记录的保管; 记录的保存

retention time.translation:
[计] 保持时间
[化] 保留时间

retention toxicosis.translation: [医] 潴留性中毒, 停滞性中毒

retentions.definition:
plural of retention
n. the act of retaining something
retentions.translation:
(retention 的复数) n. 保持, 留置, 保留, 保持力, 保留物, 记忆, 停滞, 固位
[计] 保贸, 保持

retentive.definition:
a. good at remembering
a. having the capacity to retain something
s. having the power, capacity, or quality of retaining water
retentive.translation: a. 保持的, 有保持力的, 记性好的

retentively.translation: adv. 有记性地; 记性强地; 保持地; 记性好地

retentiveness.definition: n. The quality of being retentive.
retentiveness.translation: n. 有记性; 记性强; 保持力; 好记性

retentivity.definition:
n the power of retaining and recalling past experience
n the property of retaining possessions that have been acquired
n the power of retaining liquid
retentivity.translation:
n. 保持力, 记忆力, 顽磁性
[化] 剩余磁化强度

retentor.definition:
n. A muscle which serves to retain an organ or part in
   place, esp. when retracted. See Illust. of Phylactolemata.

reterence.translation: [经] 证明人, 介绍人, 证明书

retest.translation:

retested.translation:

[化] 复试; 重新试验

retesting.translation:
v. 再试验；再检查（retest的ing形式）
n. 重新检验；重新试验

retexture.definition: n. The act of weaving or forming again.
retexture.translation: vt. 处理...使恢复原有质地
